coordinate_convention: Y up; front faces -Z; origin at footprint centre on ground
dimensions: Design targets; not measured geometry. Selected intact-front-3q is identity authority; generated side/roof views may drift.

kits.desc: A complete four-storey Los Angeles art-deco office building, warm weathered limestone, stepped vertical pilasters, four window bays across front and three bays along side, recessed brass double entrance doors, stepped flat parapet, complete flat roof with one small access hut. Intact but worn.

A complete four-storey Los Angeles Spanish revival apartment building, cream stucco and terracotta trim, four window bays across front, modest small iron balconies on upper floors, recessed ground entrance, low terracotta roof coping around flat roof, complete rear and side walls. Intact but worn.

A complete two-storey Los Angeles brick warehouse with tall lower industrial floor, aged red brick and grey mortar, steel-framed factory windows, broad closed corrugated loading shutter and a small service door, plain flat roof with brick parapet, complete side walls. Intact but worn.
Selected design has six office floors above a ground lobby (seven levels total), smoked blue-grey curtain walls, concrete base and roof service block. Use selected front as authority.

A complete three-level Los Angeles parking garage, weathered precast grey concrete frame with open horizontal parking bays, heavy safety parapets, square columns, visible slab edges and an entrance ramp, flat open roof deck with guard walls and a small stair tower. NO cars. Intact but worn.

A complete single-storey Los Angeles midcentury corner diner, L-shaped broad storefront glazing around street corner, faded sage ceramic tile piers, brushed aluminium frames, blank metal fascia with NO sign or lettering, recessed double entrance, flat roof with a low parapet and small HVAC box. Closed, empty, intact but worn.

objectives: One large city-core power generator, squat armored octagonal plinth, a vertical cylindrical cyan energy chamber protected by four teal ribs, brass coolant pipes, low accessible service console integrated into front, sturdy industrial mass. No separate objects.
One deployable communications relay, broad three-foot base, telescoping tall antenna mast, compact rotating dish and two vertical panel aerials, teal equipment enclosure with small cyan status light.

One rugged rectangular field research cache, muted teal hard case with brass corner guards, closed reinforced lid, integral carry handles, recessed small cyan sample-viewing window. Larger than a backpack, one complete case.

One deployed extraction beacon, tall slim central teal mast with cyan luminous vertical fins and a brass circular emitter head, three broad folding stabilizer feet. Beacon hardware only, no projected light beam or smoke.

One freestanding waist-height military objective terminal, squat armored pedestal, slanted protected cyan screen with blank abstract glow and no text, heavy keyed interface shapes, brass handrail corners, functional rear housing.

One OPEN orbital supply pod: upright teal armored capsule with two large front clamshell doors swung outward revealing attached shelving and supply compartments, heavy landing feet, worn brass hinges, spent nozzle beneath. No loose supplies outside pod.

One heavy ammunition supply crate, low wide teal metal chest with brass corner guards, closed segmented lid, robust carry handles, integrated vertical cartridge-shaped ribbing on front, subtle cyan status strip. No lettering or loose ammunition.

One field medical supply crate, compact upright white-and-teal hard case with worn brass corner clips, recessed cyan medical PLUS symbol built into front casing, closed lid, molded carry handle. No text or red cross.
modeling_notes: Build watertight shells and separate repeatable wall/window/door/corner/roof modules from the assembly guide.
Use the front view as primary Meshy input. Side and roof images are secondary modeling references; do not fuse contradictory details blindly.
Create intact and damaged variants with matching pivots, footprint and material IDs.
Doors and windows need deliberate openings or shallow recesses; generated images are not guaranteed to describe interiors.
Parking garage needs open bays; diner is one storey; office vertical divisions follow the target floor rise.
Reuse Round 4 facade materials after UV and scale matching. Separate glass, metal, masonry and emissive slots.
Foreground prop sizes are targets. Use simplified collisions; do not infer collision geometry from concept art.
